title: stachys annua subsp. ammophila
intro: Stachys annua subsp. ammophila, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Sea Wart, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Stachys annua subsp. ammophila include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable remedy for skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
